mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id,start_date,end_date,status FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.*,c.id IS NOT NULL AS completed,c.checked_at FROM plan_items p LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=p.id AND c.date=p.date WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId} ORDER BY p.date,p.time,p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE plans SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.plan_id,i.date FROM plan_items i JOIN plans p ON p.id=i.plan_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND i.id=#{id}
SELECT id,TRUE AS completed,checked_at AS checkedAt FROM checkins WHERE item_id=#{itemId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,task_id,title,start_date,end_date,created_at,source_deleted,include_diary,report_type,report_version FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(report_version),0)+1 FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND report_type=#{type} AND start_date=#{start} AND end_date=#{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS scheduled,COUNT(c.id) AS completed FROM plans p JOIN plan_items i ON i.plan_id=p.id LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=i.id AND c.date=i.date WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND i.date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET source_deleted=TRUE,title='源记录已变更，报告已失效', content=NULL,statistics_json=NULL,references_json=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND report_type IN ('HEALTH_WEEK','HEALTH_MONTH') AND source_deleted=FALSE AND start_date <= #{end} AND end_date >= #{start}
